_comment: Runtime plugin dependencies for android-foundation, aggregated by pipeline-orchestrator Step 0a. Every skill listed here is MANDATED by this plugin's own agents — the mapping is rules/skills.md, and each entry is traceable to an agent file. Android CLI is a SYSTEM tool, not a plugin: it is checked entirely inside android-foundation (hooks/android-cli-check.sh), never by the core, so it does not belong here.

dependencies.name: superpowers
dependencies.fallback_note: The pipeline still runs, with reduced rigor: android-ba formulates requirements without a structured brainstorm, android-developer/android-tester write code without the TDD discipline, android-reviewer and android-debugger lose their review and root-cause methodologies, and no agent runs the pre-handoff verification pass.
